method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: The Dow Jones Industrial Average learns who paid for disinflation
Equities.summary: Two cooling inflation readings carried the broad market to a record on Thursday, taking the S&P 500 through 7,800 for the first time, and Friday morning supplied the explanation for where the cooling came from.
Equities.reason: Cooling inflation readings are a clear positive driver for broad US equities, underpinning risk-on moves and record S&P levels. Macro liquidity/rates narrative dominated market move — high relevance for equity regime.

Equities.title: Nvidia discloses $21 billion stake in SpaceX at end of second quarter
Equities.summary: Nvidia's stake in SpaceX, which came through an investment in xAI, was worth about $21 billion at the end of the second quarter.
Equities.reason: Large cross-holding highlights concentration of capital in AI/mega-cap ecosystem and signals continued corporate/institutional commitment to AI-related assets — supportive for AI-led market leadership and mega-cap equities.

Equities.title: Berkshire Hathaway boosts Alphabet to a top three holding, ups Delta and housing bets
Equities.reason: Berkshire reallocating cash into big tech, airlines and housing signals veteran investor risk-on positioning and influences market positioning and sector flows; important for market leadership and rotation narratives.

Equities.title: Leveraged ETFs Snap Back as Casino Crowd Mints $50 Billion
Equities.reason: Large retail inflows into leveraged ETFs reflect elevated risk-taking and crowding that can amplify equity upside in the near term, but also increases fragility and potential for sharp reversals.

Equities.title: Jane Street took $15 billion hit in July tied to Situational Awareness, AI selloff, sources say
Equities.reason: Very large proprietary-trading losses at a major market maker/quant shop are a material negative for market liquidity and volatility expectations, raising downside risk for equities and undermining confidence in risk parity/quant flows.

Equities.title: OpenAI upheaval mounts as Sam Altman readies IPO push
Equities.summary: Executive exits and safety team changes unsettle staff as the ChatGPT maker prepares for a blockbuster listing
Equities.reason: Executive turnover and governance concerns at a flagship AI company inject sector-specific risk, potentially denting investor confidence in the AI growth narrative that has been driving equity multiples.

Equities.title: S&P 500 ends lower as investors weigh data, Middle East tensions
Equities.reason: Near-term pullback driven by mixed economic data and geopolitical risk (Middle East) flags intermittent risk-off impulses; moderate negative for sentiment but limited given recent weekly gains.

Rates.title: US Treasury yields rise as Oil strength offsets weak Retail Sales
Rates.summary: US Treasury yields advanced on Friday during the North American session after reversing their course following the release of US Retail Sales data, which disappointed investors. Meanwhile, the lack of news from the Middle East kept Oill prices higher, amid fea
Rates.reason: Headline reports yields rising as oil strength offsets weak retail sales — bond selloff narrative (yields up) is the dominant transmission to Rates; material but typical daily move.

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield inches higher as traders digest soft retail sales, monitor the Middle East
Rates.summary: The moves come after the latest retail sales figures missed expectations and the U.S. said its naval blockade of Iranian ports could continue "indefinitely."
Rates.reason: Article states 10-year yield moved higher driven by geopolitical risk (Middle East) despite soft retail sales — net bond-selloff (yields up) but with clear two-way drivers, medium-high relevance for U.S. nominal yields.

Rates.title: Treasuries Gain as Weak Retail Sales Data Erode Rate-Hike Bets
Rates.reason: Bloomberg reports Treasuries rallied after weak retail-sales reduced Fed rate-hike expectations — clear and important rates-native narrative (yields down), high relevance to market positioning and curve.

Rates.title: Summary of Opinions at the Monetary Policy Meeting on July 30 and 31, 2026
Rates.reason: Official BoJ publication of MPC opinions — informational central‑bank material. Metadata does not contain an explicit hawkish/dovish shock, so immediate directional impact on global rates is neutral/low.

Rates.title: Colombia Bond Market Perks Up After De la Espriella’s Election
Rates.reason: Local bond market reacts to political outcome with improved demand for Colombian bonds — a clear positive for domestic sovereign bond prices (yields down); relevant for EM rates flows.

Rates.title: Markets bet on rate hold, but Fed hawks may resist
Rates.reason: Headline indicates markets pricing a Fed pause (supportive for bonds) but notes potential hawkish resistance — net mildly positive for bonds as market-implied policy easing of path is the dominant signal.

Rates.title: AI’s infrastructure boom is getting more leveraged — and harder to track
Rates.summary: AI’s infrastructure boom is increasingly being funded through bonds, leases and private capital, while leveraged investors add another layer of market risk.
Rates.reason: Corporate/credit funding and increased leverage in AI infrastructure financing raise potential risk to credit spreads and fixed-income market stability — modest negative for rates (higher risk premia), but peripheral to sovereign Treasury moves.

FX.title: The Dollar Index breaks on the fourth consecutive soft print
FX.summary: The Dollar Index took a payroll contraction on August 7, a cooler consumer price reading on August 12 and a flat producer price reading on August 13 without surrendering its range. Friday's data finally did it.
FX.reason: Broad USD weakness (DXY breaking lower) is the dominant FX narrative — it lifts EUR/GBP/AUD/NZD/CAD/EM FX and drives cross-market flows. High relevance because this aggregates multiple US soft prints and signals a shift in the USD-driven regime.

FX.title: Forecasting the upcoming week: FOMC Minutes take center stage next week
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) extended its slide on Friday, holding below 100.00 at fresh lows after a fourth straight soft US data print.
FX.reason: Event-risk focus (FOMC minutes) that can reinforce the USD softening narrative; central to near-term FX positioning. Relevant as it highlights a catalyst that could confirm or reverse the recent DXY move.

FX.title: British Pound hits three-month high as weak US sales deepen USD slide
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling (GBP) rises by some 0.40% on Friday as a batch of US data supports a Federal Reserve (Fed) dovish stance, with consumer sentiment deteriorating while the disinflation process showed further progress.
FX.reason: GBP strength is an explicit transmission of USD weakness; notable move (three-month high) that fits the broader dollar-down, risk-sensitive currency-up narrative. Medium relevance as it is a major currency move tied to US data.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: Bulls eye 0.7100 after US Retail Sales miss
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar advanced on Friday after US Retail Sales disappointed investors, increasing speculation that the Federal Reserve might not raise rates, as the economy showed tentative signs of weakness. The AUD/USD trades at 0.7083, up 0.34%
FX.reason: AUD strength driven by USD softness on weaker US retail sales. This is a price-forecast/technical piece so relevance capped; it still reinforces commodity/FX response to softer US data and lower Fed hawkishness.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar charges toward 0.5900 as US Dollar loses ground
FX.summary: NZD/USD gains 0.75% on Friday and trades around 0.5895 at the time of writing, with its rally losing some momentum as it approaches the psychological 0.5900 level.
FX.reason: Clear USD-driven move in a major commodity/carry currency. Sizeable one-day move and psychologically relevant level make it a useful proximate indicator of the broader USD softness/regime shift.

FX.title: Euro: Spreads support upside bias against US Dollar – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret report EUR/USD trading in the mid-1.15s with modest gains versus the US Dollar (USD), supported by euro area Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and a return to trade surplus.
FX.reason: Macro and yield-spread narrative supporting EUR/USD gains amid USD weakness. Important for the USD-centric basket and consistent with the cross-market regime (EUR strength vs USD).

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: 100-Day SMA blocks bullish reversal
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair registers gains of over 0.32% on Friday as traders face key resistance at the 100-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) at 1.1567, as bulls eye the 1.1600 psychological figure. At the time of writing, the pair trades at 1.1564 after bouncing off dai
FX.reason: Technical/price-forecast piece on EUR/USD; supports the broader EUR strength story but capped relevance since it is a technical note rather than a macro driver.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Bears target the 200-day SMA
FX.summary: USD/CAD extends its decline farther below 1.4000 on Friday and heads for a third consecutive weekly loss. At the time of writing, the pair trades around 1.3877, at levels last seen in early July.
FX.reason: CAD strength / USD weakness reflected in USD/CAD technical move. Relevant as a major USD-cross and indicative of commodity-currency response to the softer-US-data regime; technical piece so relevance capped.

FX.title: Traders are spoiling for a fight over the yen
FX.summary: After historic US-Japan intervention on the currency, the risk of market ructions is again rising
FX.reason: High-market-impact narrative: renewed intervention risk and potential for disorder in JPY crosses. This can materially alter USD/JPY dynamics and influence global flow/positioning — judged highly relevant to FX regime and risk sentiment.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Policy risks support gains against US Dollar – Scotiabank
FX.summary: Scotiabank strategists Shaun Osborne and Eric Theoret observe USD/JPY trading near 159, with modest Japanese Yen (JPY) gains offering reassurance to the Ministry of Finance (MoF) after recent weakness.
FX.reason: Confirms policy/intervention angle and modest JPY appreciation against USD. Reinforces the FT narrative and is directly relevant to USD/JPY and global FX flows.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Steady appreciation backed by PBoC stance – Societe Generale
FX.summary: Societe Generale analysts highlight CNY’s firm trend, with the currency advancing to 6.7424, its strongest level since February 2023, on Dollar weakness and lower US yields.
FX.reason: CNY strength driven by USD weakness and lower US yields; relevant to USD/CNH and EM Asia FX flows. Important as part of the broader dollar-softer narrative, though China-specific policy nuance limits universality.

FX.title: Chinese Yuan: Activity data and PBOC stance guide FX – MUFG
FX.summary: MUFG’s Asia FX Weekly highlights that China’s July activity indicators, following weak Q2 GDP, will be central for the Chinese Yuan and regional FX.
FX.reason: Macro-data and PBoC guidance could influence CNY and regional FX; supportive of the USD-weakness-driven CNY appreciation theme but somewhat conditional on incoming Chinese activity prints.

Commodities.title: Gold rallies as weak US data dents Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold price registers solid gains of nearly 0.90% on Friday as the US Dollar weakens across the board, following a week that featured softer inflation data, which decreased the chances for a rate hike by the Federal Reserve (Fed). The XAU/USD trades at $4,386,
Commodities.reason: Direct, high‑signal link between softer US inflation / weaker USD and higher gold; Fed hike odds falling is a major macro driver for bullion (lower real yields / dollar weakness), so bullish for gold with above-average relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG stalls as yields cap recovery
Commodities.summary: Silver price advanced by some 0.39% on Friday, capped by rising US yields, even though US data was softer than expected. XAG/USD trades at $64.70, after bouncing off daily lows of $63.51.
Commodities.reason: Silver showing modest upside on softer US data but explicitly capped by rising US yields—positive metal momentum but constrained by rates; moderate relevance as a near‑term price/macro interaction.

Commodities.title: Copper: Rally pauses as Chinese demand signal softens – Commerzbank
Commodities.summary: Commerzbank’s Barbara Lambrecht observes that despite falling LME Copper stocks and trimmed output guidance from a major producer, the recent Copper rally is losing momentum.
Commodities.reason: Primary copper piece noting weakening Chinese demand signals which undercut the rally despite supply-side supportive bits; demand softening is the dominant near‑term driver, so mildly negative for copper.

Commodities.title: How a niche copper trade became a real-time gauge of Trump’s next tariff move
Commodities.summary: The widening price of copper between two metals exchanges is offering investors a gauge of U.S. tariff risk.
Commodities.reason: Article links copper pricing dispersion to potential tariff risk — introduces policy/flow uncertainty that can weigh on copper demand/pricing. Relevant but a secondary, more idiosyncratic signal.

Commodities.title: United States on track for record natural gas production in 2026
Commodities.summary: We forecast U.S. marketed natural gas production will average 122.5 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d) in 2026, surpassing the previous record of 118.5 Bcf/d set in 2025, in our August 2026 Short-Term Energy Outlook (STEO).
Commodities.reason: Clear supply increase for a core commodity — record US natural gas production is a material negative for gas prices (greater supply, downward pressure on price), making this high‑relevance and meaningfully bearish.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin slips as U.S. inflation fails to spark gains, ETFs see August's first two-day drawdown
Crypto.reason: Market reaction piece: US inflation data failed to boost BTC, contributing to short-term selling pressure. Direction negative for crypto prices; relevance moderate as a market-moving intraday driver.

Crypto.title: Trump family-backed crypto firm World Liberty gets conditional bank charter approval
Crypto.summary: The OCC conditionally approved World Liberty Trust Co.’s national trust bank charter. That would allow the Trump family-backed firm to issue stablecoins.
Crypto.reason: Major regulatory/charter approval enabling stablecoin issuance by a politically prominent firm — positive for institutional stablecoin adoption and broader crypto on‑ramp prospects. High relevance due to potential structural impact.

Crypto.title: Tokenization stocks slip as SEC delay puts 'speed bump' in crypto’s Wall Street push
Crypto.reason: Market reaction to SEC delays on tokenization policy — negative for tokenization adoption and related equities, representing a direct near-term headwind to institutional crypto integration.

Crypto.title: U.S. SEC to again delay 'innovation exemption' for tokenization amid Wall Street, White House concerns
Crypto.reason: Regulatory delay on an innovation exemption is a direct policy headwind to tokenization and institutional product rollouts — more significant negative implication for adoption timelines.

Crypto.title: SEC cancels long-awaited proposal of Reg Crypto, postponing meeting without new date
Crypto.reason: Cancellation/postponement of a major regulatory proposal creates prolonged uncertainty for market structure and compliance — a significant negative for industry clarity and near-term institutional flows.

Crypto.title: Tether says it completed long-promised 'Big Four' audit of finances behind $180 billion USDT stablecoin
Crypto.reason: Completion of a Big Four audit for a major stablecoin issuer improves transparency/credibility — net positive for market trust in stablecoins and liquidity flows.

Crypto.title: Cluster of headwinds weigh on bitcoin. XRP teeters near $1
Crypto.reason: Synthesis piece outlining multiple negative drivers for BTC (macro, regulatory, flows) — negative directional signal for crypto sentiment and price momentum.

Crypto.title: Trump expected to attend White House meeting with crypto CEOs, sources say
Crypto.reason: High-level political engagement with crypto leadership signals potential for favorable/regulatory engagement and legitimacy — meaningful positive for policy outlook and institutional confidence.

Crypto.title: Israel’s largest bank to offer crypto trading with Galaxy
Crypto.reason: Major bank partnership to offer crypto trading indicates expanding institutional/bank distribution channels — positive for adoption and flows into crypto.

Crypto.title: Trezor warns 14,000 customers after fulfilment partner suffers data breach
Crypto.reason: Security/data-breach incident affecting a hardware wallet vendor undermines user trust and raises operational risk — negative but limited to affected custody/retail segments.

Crypto.title: Figure revenue doubles as blockchain loan marketplace volumes surge
Crypto.reason: Stronger growth in a blockchain lending marketplace signals rising on‑chain credit activity and product adoption — constructive for the DeFi/credit segment.

Crypto.title: B2C2 taps Schroders veteran to chase Asia’s growing crypto wealth
Crypto.reason: Hiring to expand Asian wealth-market coverage reflects institutionalization and distribution growth in a key region — positive but modest impact.

Crypto.title: Crypto platform operator gets 15-year prison sentence in South Korea due to $50 million scam
Crypto.reason: Severe criminal enforcement highlights fraud risks in crypto platforms — negative for consumer trust and regulatory scrutiny, though jurisdictional.

Crypto.title: JPMorgan shuttered its banking relationship with predictions platform Polymarket: FT
Crypto.reason: Loss of a banking relationship for a crypto-adjacent platform signals continued banking frictions and operational risk — modestly negative for ecosystem access.

Crypto.title: Forecasts for $1 million bitcoin price likely look too ambitious, key ratio suggests
Crypto.reason: Valuation/price-target skepticism piece — modest bearish signal but is a price-forecast-style article (lower relevance by framework).
